stem:
Pallavi looks at the diagram. She has drawn base $DE$ of length $7\,\mathrm{cm}$. She must build triangle $DEF$ with $DF = 6\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $EF = 5\,\mathrm{cm}$.

Where should she place point $F$?

options.text: At a meeting point of an arc from $D$ of radius $6\,\mathrm{cm}$ and an arc from $E$ of radius $5\,\mathrm{cm}$.
Anywhere on the dashed arc drawn from $D$, because that arc is labelled first.
On the midpoint of segment $DE$, because $DE$ is the drawn base.
At endpoint $E$, because $E$ already sits on the base.

teacher.key_rationale: F must be 6 cm from D and 5 cm from E, so it lies at an intersection of those two arcs. Using only one arc omits the second distance; the midpoint or endpoint E grab the base instead of the third vertex.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source triangle as base DE with dashed arcs of radii 6 cm and 5 cm meeting at F.
